hypothesised_pattern: Rows with x2 and x5 both positive and |x4| below 0.9 are class_1, rows with opposite signs are class_0, and |x4| above about 1.1 with a small product is class_2.
functional_form_guess: if |x4| > 1.1 and |x2*x5| < 1 then class_2, else if x2*x5 > 0 then class_1, else class_0
rationale: Seven rows are class_1 with both x2 and x5 positive and |x4| of at most 0.89, and two rows are class_0 with x2 negative and x5 positive. Row 9 is class_2 with |x4| of 1.16 and a product of about 0.07.
